original.target_description: Verified title and authors: Violence and Election Fraud: Evidence from Afghanistan, Weidmann and Callen. District-level 2009 Afghanistan presidential election analyses; Table 2 (p. 72) contains four models with linear and squared violence terms, and Table 3 (p. 73) contains candidate-specific analyses. Assigned input has no study, outcome, sample, model, term or test locator, so the intended test cannot be uniquely established.

replication.target_description: Verified report title/project: Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate 4 claims from Weidmann_BritJournPoliSci_2013_JRpA; Yinxian Zhang, SCORE RR ID 2g7ky, OSF bcqem. District-level 2014 Afghanistan presidential election analyses cover four claims, simple and complex inferential criteria, and alternative fraud outcomes. Assigned input has no claim, outcome, model or test locator, so the intended test cannot be uniquely established.

notes: Both primary sources were acquired and titles verified. Original DOI matches the title. Supplied replication URL https://osf.io/8mqzu identifies the report file rather than a project node; the project bcqem explicitly supplied in the reference lists the matching report at https://osf.io/download/8mqzu/. The original contains multiple eligible tests, and the replication evaluates four separate claims with differing author verdicts. Neither audit ID has a neutral description or test locator; the requested metric labels alone do not uniquely identify a test. No assignment was inferred from input order, and no paper-level verdict was substituted for an unidentified effect. Null statistics reflect insufficient effect locators, not unavailable papers. No effect-size conversions performed.
